items.exampleEn: The chairman opened the meeting at nine.
items.exampleZh: 董事長九點宣佈會議開始。

items.exampleEn: My father will retire next year.
My boss lets me leave early on Fridays.
items.exampleZh: 我老闆讓我星期五早點下班。

items.exampleEn: This company is a famous car maker.
items.exampleZh: 這家公司是知名的汽車製造商。

items.exampleEn: The assistant cook cuts all the vegetables.
items.exampleZh: 助理廚師負責切所有的蔬菜。

items.exampleEn: I have an appointment at the bank at ten.

items.sentenceEn: After he retired, he started to learn the piano.

items.audioEn: The boss is busy, so please talk to his secretary.
items.audioZh: 老闆在忙，請找他的秘書談。

items.sentenceEn: I made an appointment for next Monday.
My great-grandmother is alive and very healthy.
items.sentenceZh: 我的曾祖母還健在，而且非常健康。

items.stemEn: He is sixty-five and tired of working, so he wants to ____.
items.stemZh: 他六十五歲了，工作得很累，所以想退休。

items.stemEn: I'm the boss here, and Tom is my ____ manager. He helps me every day.
items.stemZh: 我是這裡的老闆，Tom 是我的副理，他每天都協助我。

items.passageEn: Grandpa Lin was the chairman of a small company, a maker of wooden toys, for thirty years. Last month, he finally retired. At a party on his last day, his secretary and his assistant manager gave short speeches. "He was a kind boss," they said. Now Grandpa Lin plays chess with his friends every afternoon.
items.passageZh: 林爺爺在一家生產木製玩具的小公司當了三十年董事長。上個月，他終於退休了。在他最後一天上班的派對上，他的秘書和副理都簡短致詞。他們說：「他是個很親切的老闆。」現在林爺爺每天下午都和朋友下棋。

questions.questionZh: 林爺爺以前是做什麼的？
林爺爺現在每天下午做什麼？

referenceEn: I forgot about my appointment today.
rubricZh: 「忘了」用過去式（例如 forgot、forgot about）

items.instructionZh: 用 boss 造一個句子，說說你或家人的老闆。
referenceEn: My boss is very kind to everyone.
My mother's boss never comes to work late.
rubricZh: boss 是可數名詞（例如 my boss、her boss）
主詞第三人稱單數時動詞加 s（例如 comes）
